[EN] The sikandaris were content to wait for Sikander's awakening. Something's gotten them off their tailfeathers and involved in this madness!

Something tells me we don't have to look much further than the Atel Akaad to see Killian's black fingers pulling the strings.
[ES] Los sikandaris se contentaban con esperar el despertar de Sikander. ¡Algo los ha sacado de quicio y los ha metido en esta locura!

Algo me dice que no tenemos que buscar mucho más allá de Atel Akaad para ver los negros hilos de Killian moviendo los fichas.
